messages:
evie: kicking off onboarding for alcyone-embed-v1 — quick smoke on our standard holdout. short-query recall@10 seems lower than expected :thinking_face:
marco: how much lower? numbers pls
evie: baseline heron-int4 recall@10 (short<20 toks) = 0.82. alcyone float16 = 0.76. fullset: heron 0.822 vs alcyone 0.815.
sanjay: are we comparing same preprocessing? tokenization, truncation?
evie: yes, same pipeline. used the onboarding harness (same seed). sharing the eval snippet:
```bash
python eval_holdout.py --model alcyone-embed-v1 --cohort shortqueries --k 10 --seed 42
# output (excerpt)
# recall@10: 0.760
# mean_cosine_sim: 0.214
```
lia: uMAP on that cohort shows more fragmented clusters vs heron, seems like intra-class variance up. did norm shift check?
evie: ran L2-norm histogram — alcyone mean norm = 0.94, heron = 1.02. small but might affect cosine distances.
tanya: any quant tests yet? int8/int6?
evie: quick ORT int8 quant -> overall recall@10 0.79, shortqueries 0.74. int6 knocked another ~0.03. float16 is same as fp32 within noise.
marco: curious if switching similarity metric helps (cosine vs dot)
evie: switched to cosine, short recall@10 jumped +0.02 to 0.78. so normization helps partially.
lia: maybe try per-cohort whitening / centering like we did for pelican. small calibrate transform could recover the rest.
sanjay: also run small clustering-aware calibration: per-class mean subtraction on dev fold and test again.
evie: will try a quick centering pass and re-run. posting CI run link: <https://ci.redwood/example/alpharun/1234> (ci-bot: build passed)
ci-bot: #1234 pipeline finished — eval artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/alcyone/1769991230/
ops-bot: FYI reserved a mini-dedicated job for longer sweep tomorrow 02:00 UTC :calendar:
marco: plan: 1) center/whiten sweep, 2) try per-layer mean scaling, 3) test prod quant profile with ORT int8 calibration. If still bad, escalate to model team for retrain.
evie: agreed. I'll post updated numbers in this thread after the centering sweep (~couple hours). thanks all :thumbsup:
